user.title: Ring Intercom Video Camera
user.description: Adds a WebRTC camera entity for every Ring Intercom Video device discovered through the official Ring integration. No credentials are needed — authentication is reused from the Ring integration. Submit to finish setup.

abort.already_configured: Already configured. Only a single instance is needed.
abort.ring_not_configured: The official Ring integration must be set up before adding this integration.

path_not_allowed.message: Cannot write {filename}: no access to that path. Add it to allowlist_external_dirs.

audio_session_active.message: {entity_id} already has an audio session in progress.

deprecated_yaml.title: Ring Intercom Video Camera YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description: Configuring Ring Intercom Video Camera via `configuration.yaml` is deprecated and has been automatically imported into the UI. Remove the `ring_intercom_camera:` entry from your `configuration.yaml` to fix this issue.

record.name: Record clip
record.description: Records a video clip from the intercom camera through a server-side WebRTC session and saves it as an MP4 file. Use this instead of camera.record, which requires an RTSP/HLS stream this camera doesn't have.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Full path of the output MP4 file. Must be inside an allowed path (e.g. under /media).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Length of the recording in seconds.

enable_audio.name: Enable audio
enable_audio.description: Negotiate an outgoing audio channel so say/play_media can send audio to the intercom while this recording runs. Off by default (no audio is sent to the device).

play_media.name: Play media
play_media.description: Plays an audio file or URL through the intercom's speaker via a server-side WebRTC session. Reuses an active recording/audio session if one is running, otherwise opens its own.

media.name: Media
media.description: Path or URL of the audio to play (anything ffmpeg can read, e.g. an MP3/WAV file or an HTTP URL).

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Maximum length of the playback session in seconds.

gain.name: Gain
gain.description: Volume multiplier (hard-clipped). Default 6 boosts the typically-quiet audio so it's audible on the panel; use 1 for no boost.

say.name: Say (TTS)
say.description: Speaks a text message through the intercom's speaker using Home Assistant's text-to-speech. Reuses an active recording/audio session if one is running, otherwise opens its own.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language code for the TTS engine (e.g. es, en). Optional.

engine.name: TTS engine
engine.description: TTS engine to use (entity id or platform). Optional — the default engine is used if omitted.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Maximum length of the playback session in seconds.

gain.name: Gain
gain.description: Volume multiplier (hard-clipped). Default 6 boosts the typically-quiet TTS so it's audible on the panel; use 1 for no boost.
